basic_info.description: 225 Jones St is a 20-Unit mixed-use Multifamily building located in the Tenderloin. It is an excellent renovation opportunity with   substantial upside for investors who are motivated. It consists of 16 large studio apartments, ranging in size from +/- 350-400 square   feet each. 14 of the studios are currently vacant. On the ground level, there are 4 commercial spaces, two of which are occupied by a   city favorite, Yemen Kitchen and the other, by the popular Hung Phat Bakery, both are on month-to-month basis. The building is located   just around the corner from the Tenderloin Police Station.  There is an impressive return on investment for buyers who are ready to renovate and stabilize the asset. Market rents for the renovated   studios range between $1,300-$1,400 a month while the commercial spaces command +/1 $1,700 a month. The adjacent apartment   building has high occupancy and attracts many interested tenants because of its attractive price point. Our firm has recently placed 5   commercial Tenants in the Tenderloin ranging from nonprofits to small retailers. We currently represent 15+ commercial spaces in the   Tenderloin and have been filling properties quickly as interest is high.
